title: REPORT on human rights and democracy in the world and the European Union’s policy on the matter – annual report 2025
part_text: 5b. Stresses that, in contexts of conflict and forced displacement, the burden of caregiving falls disproportionately on women and girls, limiting their access to education, employment and political participation; calls for the EU’s humanitarian aid to include measures to support caregivers;
